interface.name: pd_window_position_manager_v1

description.summary: where the compositor placed a client's windows

interface.description: Wayland keeps window positions with the compositor. AppKit reports frames in screen coordinates, so a window learns where it is from this.

interface.name: pd_window_position_v1
interface.description: Sent once when created and again every time the compositor moves the window.

request.name: set_position

description.summary: where the client wants its window

request.description: Top left in global compositor coordinates. Wayland leaves placement to the compositor, an AppKit window still opens and moves where the app put it.

description.summary: top left of the window in global compositor coordinates
